data.narrative:
Cognitive Space is a seed-stage company in Space & Aerospace that has raised $10.3M to date. The sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though the tight filtering required for direct peer matching limits the applicability of conventional benchmarking approaches.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method here. Using total capital raised as a proxy for seed valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $26M. This approach is sound given Cognitive Space's stage and fundraising profile, though it relies on the assumption that future funding will proceed at standard pace and terms.

Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue; the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 27.4x PS across the five public tickers, but this multiple cannot be anchored to a private company lacking public financials. Peer-median analysis similarly cannot proceed—only one same-stage comparable exists in the filtered dataset, well below the three-datapoint threshold for statistical reliability. The triangulated range of $22–$30M (median $26M) therefore rests on a single methodology. Key uncertainties include the sustainability of the stage-progression multiplier absent market conditions or funding velocity data, and the absence of revenue or EBITDA metrics, which would enable revenue or profitability-based cross-checks.
